# 1 Clement Chapter 48 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 48 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 48

**48:1** Therefore let us quickly mend these divisions and fall down before the Master and entreat him with tears, beseeching him to be merciful and to be reconciled to us, and to restore us to our honorable and pure conduct of brotherly love.

**48:2** For this is the gateway of righteousness opened unto life, as it is written: "Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter through them and give praise to the LORD.

**48:3** This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it."

**48:4** Therefore, while many gates stand open, this gate of righteousness that is in Christ is the gate of blessedness — and all who enter through it and order their way in holiness and righteousness, performing all things without confusion, are blessed.

**48:5** Let a man be faithful; let him be capable of declaring knowledge; let him be wise in the discernment of words; let him be pure in his actions —

**48:6** for the greater he appears to be, the more he ought to be humble-minded, and to seek the benefit of all rather than his own.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
